executive_summary: Register Michael's 11 spec gauges, the michael_handoff coordination kind, and the Adam personal-day-lane carve-out encode tooling — closing three infrastructure gaps child A deliberately deferred to this child.

functional_requirements.requirement: Register all 11 spec-§9 gauges in lib/governance/gauge-registry.js with ownerRole:'michael'
functional_requirements.description: Add michael-brief-landed, michael-feeder-health, michael-seat-uptime, michael-oauth-health, michael-classifier-drift, michael-gmail-modify-ceiling, michael-surface-rate, michael-reopen-rate, michael-overdue-cleared, michael-ledger-gap, michael-account-independence as stub entries: real string detectorFn matching each id, enabled:false, thresholdConfig.tripWhen, ownerRole:'michael', remediation, prevent, tracesToLayer:null. michael-token-budget is explicitly excluded (spec-deferred). Mirrors the existing adam_self_score_age/coordinator_self_score_age/solomon_self_score_age stub pattern (gauge-registry.js:211-242).
acceptance_criteria: GAUGE_REGISTRY contains exactly 11 new entries with ownerRole==='michael', enabled===false, and a non-empty string detectorFn equal to each entry's id
grep for 'michael-token-budget' in gauge-registry.js returns nothing
tests/unit/governance/gauge-registry.test.js is updated: toHaveLength(30) becomes toHaveLength(41); the 27-live/3-stub-id assertion is extended to include the 11 new michael stub ids

functional_requirements.requirement: Register PAYLOAD_KINDS.MICHAEL_HANDOFF and add it to DRAIN_SETS.michael in lib/fleet/worker-status.cjs
functional_requirements.description: Add MICHAEL_HANDOFF: 'michael_handoff' to the PAYLOAD_KINDS object (worker-status.cjs:74-129) and append PAYLOAD_KINDS.MICHAEL_HANDOFF to the existing DRAIN_SETS.michael array (worker-status.cjs:410-415), whose own comment at :405-409 names this child as the one that closes this registration.
acceptance_criteria: PAYLOAD_KINDS.MICHAEL_HANDOFF === 'michael_handoff'
DRAIN_SETS.michael.includes('michael_handoff') is true
no other role's DRAIN_SETS entries change

functional_requirements.requirement: Add a chairman-gated database/migrations/ file inserting the michael_handoff kind into role_drain_sets
functional_requirements.description: INSERT INTO role_drain_sets (role, kind, provenance) VALUES ('michael', 'michael_handoff', 'SD-LEO-ORCH-MICHAEL-ROLE-FORMALIZATION-002-G') ON CONFLICT (role, kind, direction) DO NOTHING, header '-- @approved-by: PENDING — chairman-gated apply required (do NOT apply outside it)', matching the exact shape of database/migrations/20260906_role_drain_sets_add_worker_signal.sql. NOT applied by this session.
acceptance_criteria: the migration file exists under database/migrations/, carries the PENDING approval header, and is purely additive (no existing row touched)
tests/unit/fleet/drain-set-registry.test.js passes, confirming JS-floor (FR-2) and migration (FR-3) parity

functional_requirements.requirement: Add exactly one new line to declaredAddresseeRole in lib/coordinator/dispatch.cjs for michael_handoff
functional_requirements.description: Immediately after the existing 'if (payload.kind === "solomon_consult") return "solomon";' line (dispatch.cjs:271), add 'if (payload.kind === "michael_handoff") return "michael";'. Required by the chairman-ratified Solomon Q6 adjudication (docs/michael/05-SOLOMON-ADJUDICATION.md), which names declaredAddresseeRole explicitly and treats a partial registration (this line omitted) as the untyped-row defect class. This is a scoped, precedented, one-line addition, not the open-ended widening the function's own 'do not widen without a measured occurrence' comment warns against — Solomon's cited real incident (an untyped row landing at 13:56Z, 2026-09-05) is itself the measured occurrence.
acceptance_criteria: declaredAddresseeRole({kind:'michael_handoff'}) returns 'michael'
declaredAddresseeRole's existing solomon/adam behavior is unchanged (regression-free)
git diff to dispatch.cjs for this FR is exactly one added line

functional_requirements.description: New file draining DRAIN_SETS.michael kinds (including michael_handoff from FR-2) using the drain pattern of scripts/solomon-advisory.cjs (DRAIN_SETS.solomon.filter/inbox+orphan predicates/resolveRecognizedKinds), but exporting only inbox/drain functionality — Michael's seat sends nothing outbound through this path (michael-register.cjs:407). Already referenced by shipped child-A code: michael-register.cjs:297 lazy-requires { drainMichaelOutbound } from this exact path, michael-quiet-tick.mjs:148 calls it, .claude/commands/michael.md:71 documents its --quiet flag.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/michael-inbox.cjs exists and exports drainMichaelOutbound(supabase, {newSessionId, oldSessionIds}) returning {moved}
requiring the file from michael-register.cjs's existing lazy-require call site succeeds (no MODULE_NOT_FOUND)
the drain reads exactly DRAIN_SETS.michael's kind set, no more and no less

functional_requirements.requirement: Build the Adam-carve-out encode script (tooling only, not the chairman ratification itself)
functional_requirements.description: A script mirroring the confirmed precedent scripts/one-off/qf-20260905-813-encode-lens-predicates.mjs (SECTION_ID const, verbatim OLD_CLAUSE, an includes()-count-must-equal-1 guard, replace, --dry-run default, then CLAUDE.md regeneration), targeting leo_protocol_sections id=601 (adam_role_contract, section 5g 'CHAIRMAN SMS CHANNEL DUTY', which already carries a forward reference at char ~91692 saying the clause is 'encoded by child G') AND the michael_role_contract leo_protocol_sections row in one pass — the ratification writer's marker cross-check (lib/chairman/ratification-writer.mjs:167-238) requires the identical literal clause text in every named target contract's rendered file, so updating only adam_role_contract would fail that check the day the chairman actually ratifies. No chairman_ratifications row is created by this child — that is a chairman-only in-terminal act; the script requires an existing ratification row as a precondition and stays inert (refuses cleanly) until one exists.
acceptance_criteria: the encode script's dry-run mode against fixture content updates both target sections together or refuses cleanly if either target's marker count is not exactly 1
running the script twice against unchanged fixture content is a no-op on the second run
no code path in this child's own tests or scripts calls recordChairmanRatification against a live client

technical_requirements.rationale: Its untyped_row check fires on a missing/null/empty payload.kind only, not an unrecognized-but-present one — once michael_handoff is registered elsewhere (FR-2/FR-3) a real row carrying it is never flagged, satisfying Solomon's Q6 condition that the gauge 'reads it' with zero code change. Verified by a test, not a new code path.
Already registers 'michael' (child A, peer-target.cjs:36,106) — touching it again would be redundant, unreviewable churn.
Already includes 'michael' (child A, ratification-writer.mjs:30) — this SD's original boilerplate description implied it as new work; LEAD confirmed it is already done.

technical_requirements.requirement: The 11 new gauges ship as registry stub entries with enabled:false and a non-null detectorFn string; detector resolver wiring in scripts/gauge-runner.mjs's buildDetectorResolvers() is optional for this PR (the runner skips an unresolved key non-fatally, gauge-runner.mjs:753)
technical_requirements.rationale: Detection logic for several gauges (e.g. michael-classifier-drift, michael-surface-rate) depends on live feeder data this child does not own; registering the slot now (per the STUB-ROW ADOPTION CONTRACT documented at gauge-registry.js:10-19) avoids a build-order deadlock on sibling detector work.

system_architecture.overview: Three independent, additive registration surfaces closing gaps child A deliberately deferred: (1) a data-only registry array gaining 11 stub rows, (2) a coordination-kind registration spanning a JS constant, a JS array, a chairman-gated DB migration, and one precedented line in an existing role-resolution function, backed by a new drain script, and (3) a text-encode utility mirroring an existing precedent script, targeting two leo_protocol_sections rows in one transactional pass.

components.responsibility: Reserve 11 registry slots for Michael's go-live invariants without depending on sibling detector SDs shipping first

components.name: worker-status.cjs kind/drain-set registration
components.responsibility: Make michael_handoff a real, typed, drainable payload kind for the michael role

components.responsibility: Persist the michael_handoff/michael pairing in the DB-backed drain-set registry, kept in parity with the JS floor by an existing test

components.name: dispatch.cjs declaredAddresseeRole entry
components.responsibility: Detect a mis-delivered michael_handoff row at insert time, per Solomon's ratified Q6 adjudication

components.name: scripts/michael-inbox.cjs
components.responsibility: Drain DRAIN_SETS.michael kinds for the Michael seat (inbox-only, no send path)
components.technology: CJS script mirroring scripts/solomon-advisory.cjs's drain pattern

components.name: Adam-carve-out encode script
components.responsibility: Mechanically encode a chairman-ratified clause into both adam_role_contract and michael_role_contract once ratified, staying inert until then

system_architecture.data_flow: Gauges: gauge-runner.mjs reads GAUGE_REGISTRY on its cadence, skips disabled/unresolved entries non-fatally. Kind registration: a session_coordination insert targeting the michael seat with payload.kind='michael_handoff' now passes declaredAddresseeRole's role check, lands as a typed row, and is picked up by scripts/michael-inbox.cjs's drain against DRAIN_SETS.michael (JS floor) unioned with role_drain_sets (DB floor) via lib/fleet/drain-set-registry.js. Carve-out: the encode script reads leo_protocol_sections rows 601 (adam) and the michael_role_contract row, verifies each target's marker occurs exactly once, replaces both, then triggers CLAUDE.md regeneration.
integration_points: scripts/gauge-runner.mjs (gauge stub consumption, no change required this PR)
michael-register.cjs:297 / michael-quiet-tick.mjs:148 (existing consumers of scripts/michael-inbox.cjs, unmodified call sites)
lib/fleet/drain-set-registry.js resolveRecognizedKinds (unions the JS floor and the DB-backed role_drain_sets rows)
lib/chairman/ratification-writer.mjs (precondition consumer for the encode script; not modified)

scripts/michael-inbox.cjs exists, exports drainMichaelOutbound with the exact signature already depended on by shipped child-A code, and is covered by a unit test

risks.risk: The 11 gauge stub entries silently fail gauge-registry.test.js's exact-count assertions if the PR misses updating the hardcoded 30/41 and stub-id-list expectations
risks.mitigation: Update the test file's counts in the same commit as the registry additions; run the full test file locally before considering the FR done
risks.rollback_plan: Revert the gauge-registry.js and test file changes together; no data or migration involved

risks.risk: Adding a line to declaredAddresseeRole, a function explicitly commented against unscoped widening, sets a precedent for future uncontrolled additions if the ratification-backed justification is lost from the commit history
risks.mitigation: The added line's inline comment cites docs/michael/05-SOLOMON-ADJUDICATION.md Q6 by name so the justification travels with the code, not just the PR description
risks.rollback_plan: Remove the single added line; declaredAddresseeRole reverts to exactly its pre-SD behavior, no other change entangled

risks.risk: The chairman-gated role_drain_sets migration is written correctly but never applied (chairman action pending), leaving the JS floor as the only live behavior until then
risks.mitigation: lib/fleet/drain-set-registry.js's union semantics mean the JS floor (FR-2) alone already delivers correct drain behavior immediately — the migration exists for DB/JS parity, not as the sole source of truth
risks.rollback_plan: N/A — migration is additive and staged; no rollback needed if never applied

deliverables: encode script mirroring the qf-20260905-813 precedent
unit test covering idempotency and the dual-target refusal guard

technical_decisions: Gauge stubs use a real string detectorFn (not null) because the live test suite enforces it, even though the registry file's own header comment describes a null-based STUB-ROW pattern that no live entry actually uses — the test is the authoritative contract

declaredAddresseeRole gains exactly one line rather than being left untouched, because the chairman-ratified Solomon Q6 adjudication is a higher-authority source than a generic code-level scoping comment, and the addition mirrors an existing precedented line rather than introducing new logic
The Adam-carve-out ratification itself is explicitly out of scope — this child ships tooling only, consistent with every other Michael migration's chairman-gated, staged-not-applied posture
